item.text:
Bottom line: **mixed, leaning yes** on 7B.9. I found real 2024 evidence of anti-graft discipline and formal oversight that cuts against naked patronage, but the stronger counterpattern is selective party control, delayed disclosure, and punishment of critics rather than clean, neutral administration. I did **not** find credible direct 2024 proof of Trọng personally using family-based nepotism or pardon trading; the evidence is mostly system-level and indirect.

**Evidence for a cleaner / less patronage-driven reading**
- **Vietnam's Communist Party reprimands labour minister amid anti-graft campaign** — Reuters via MarketScreener, 2024-04-19, https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/AIC-INC-16083583/news/Vietnam-s-Communist-Party-reprimands-labour-minister-amid-anti-graft-campaign-46478047/  
  Claim: The Politburo publicly disciplined a minister over ministry-linked bidding and vocational-project violations, showing real pressure against procurement abuse and insider favoritism. IDs: `7B.9`; also `7B.7`, `7B.6`.

- **Vietnam police arrest former head of government office amid anti-graft crackdown** — Reuters via Yahoo, 2024-05-04, https://www.yahoo.com/news/vietnam-police-arrest-former-head-115846721.html  
  Claim: A former top government-office chief was arrested in a bribery probe, suggesting the anti-graft drive reached high-level insiders rather than protecting connected figures. IDs: `7B.9`; also `7B.7`.

- **State Audit Office of Viet Nam - Milestones of 2024** — State Audit Office of Viet Nam, 2024, https://www.sav.gov.vn/en/Pages/detail.aspx?ItemID=265&l=News  
  Claim: The SAV says 2024 audit standards and legal documents were built around power control, anti-corruption, disciplinary enforcement, personnel rotation, and auditing, which is formal counterweight evidence against pure clientelism. IDs: `7B.9`; also `7B.6`, `7B.8`.

- **Vietnam minister says president's resignation has not affected policies** — Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-03-26, https://www.investing.com/news/economy/vietnam-hopes-us-will-soon-recognize-its-market-economy-status-fm-son-says-3353681  
  Claim: The foreign minister described Vietnam as operating through collective leadership, with policy continuity not hinging on one person, which is weak but real evidence against highly personalistic, transaction-driven rule. IDs: `7B.9`; also `7B.8`.

**Evidence for manipulation / selective control / favor-seeking behavior**
- **Politburo issues notice on Party General Secretary's health** — Government of Viet Nam, 2024-07-18, https://en.baochinhphu.vn/politburo-issues-notice-on-party-general-secretarys-health-111240718161208612.htm  
  Claim: The state disclosed Trọng’s condition only when it transferred authority to Tô Lâm, which is strong evidence of delayed, politically managed disclosure on a sensitive matter. IDs: `7B.9`; also `7B.8`, `7B.7`.

- **Vietnam: Freedom on the Net 2024 Country Report** — Freedom House, 2024, https://freedomhouse.org/country/vietnam/freedom-net/2024  
  Claim: Freedom House says mainstream media did not report Trọng’s weeks-long absence, and that authorities tightly controlled online content and induced self-censorship, which is direct evidence against open access to public information. IDs: `7B.9`; also `7B.7`, `7B.6`.

- **Vietnam arrests two well-known Facebook users over democratic freedom abuse** — Reuters via Yahoo, 2024-06-08, https://www.yahoo.com/news/vietnam-arrests-two-well-known-034901151.html  
  Claim: Police arrested journalist Truong Huy San and lawyer Tran Dinh Trien after critical Facebook posts, searched their homes, and charged them with abusing democratic freedoms, which looks like punishment for scrutiny rather than neutral enforcement. IDs: `7B.9`; also `7B.7`, `7B.6`.

- **Rights group accuses Vietnam misleading US on human trafficking** — Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-06-20, https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/rights-group-accuses-vietnam-misleading-us-on-human-trafficking-3490556  
  Claim: Reuters reported allegations that officials were told to withhold information and present anti-trafficking efforts more favorably to Washington, which is direct evidence of reputational information manipulation. IDs: `7B.9`; also `7B.8`, `7B.7`.

**Search gap**
- I did **not** find solid 2024 reporting that directly documents Trọng using family nepotism, explicit favoritism in appointments, or pardon-trading for private advantage.
- The most relevant evidence is instead indirect: anti-graft purges that were real but party-led, plus heavy information control and selective punishment of critics.
- After **2024-07-18**, direct attribution to Trọng weakens sharply because the Politburo transferred his duties to Tô Lâm and Trọng died on **2024-07-19**.
